en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard with two photographs. The upper image shows a large, ornate two‑story building in historicist style with steep gables and the word "TIVOLI" displayed on its facade. It stands behind a fence along a street with some trees visible. The lower image shows the lavishly decorated interior of a large hall set up for a banquet or ball, with very long rows of tables and chairs, folded napkins, and festive garlands and flags hanging from the ceiling. Text beneath the images identifies the location as the concert and ballroom "Tivoli" in Freiberg in Saxony.
